comparators.history_days_observed: the observed retention of the real market
comparators.usable: eligible: every decision hour of the segment

eligible: every decision hour of the segment (before the sealed start)
observed: the store's build time (meta created_at); for BingX real-market stores the server time of the fetch of the chunks holding the first and the last candle; history depth observed = the first candle's age at its chunk's fetch, only when the store's provenance records that a backfill established the start of the exchange's history at that candle and the last fetch of its chunk kept no candle from the archive alone; otherwise null with the reason (a run that its --max-chunks bound stops leaves the history start open)
reads: open times only, through read_study_frame up to the sealed start, in calendar-year ranges, with the meta under the store's source lock held shared; each read verifies the CSV sha256 against the meta, and the gaps read must equal the meta's

retention.warning: the newest archived 1m or 5m chunk is older than a third of its retention (kronos_agent.data.bingx_history.retention_warnings)

sealed: decision hours at or after the sealed start are not counted (gate 6); open times and counts at or after it come from the store meta, never a value

segments.before_training: from the hour of the store's first candle to the training start

stores_listed: every built store (source x interval) from its meta: rows, first and last open (UTC), the date observed, gaps as [first_missing, end) ranges
title: Coverage of the candle stores
usable_rule: a decision hour D is usable for a window of H hours at an interval when every candle of that interval opening in [D - H h, D) is present; the candle opening at D is not needed; missing candles are never filled
